title: Annotatio IV §.III close: More in Stregensis’s Northern Olive-branch — stop before Annotatio V Limites
pass_a_gloss: Collect more from the Northern Olive-branch of John Matthew, Bishop of Strängnäs — the Fourth, Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth Berry.
pass_b_english: Gather more from the Northern Olive-branch of Johannes Matthiae, Bishop of Strängnäs — berries four, six, seven, and eight.
Stop before Annotatio V (Limites Consociationis Ecclesiasticae).
source_text: Plura collige ex Ramo Olivae Septentrionalis Joh. Matthaei Stregensis Episcopi, Bacca quartâ, Sexta, Septima & Octava.
notes: Stregensis Ramus Olivae Baccae; stop before Annotatio V.
